entry_state: The declared proportional loss allocation includes finance as well as service. Reinsurance tracks the covered component within its asset without a second CSM reversal. The connected year-one balances reconcile to equity 83; final settlement is next.
exit_state: Connected groups close at cash and equity 88.3, but different recognition histories reach that same endpoint. Each event must validate and publish complete measurements atomically; exact retry returns the original receipt without repeating accounting. PAA eligibility and claim measurement now require their own conditions.
findings: Late treaty recognition and incorrect pooling can preserve final cash 88.3 while changing or misstating intermediate equity. The text distinguishes the valid alternative from the invalid pooling.
The four events preserve finance, service, incurrence and settlement states; cash stays 250 through incurrence before falling to 173.
A balanced extra recovery-component posting still overstates asset and income. Complete component validation precedes receipt lookup.

Exact retry returns generation-one state while reporting the observed generation-four head; it neither re-applies finance nor replaces current state. Runtime durability remains untested. No new defect observed.
